issues.title: Default LIVE adapter can never resolve DNS
SSRF guard neither normalizes all private addresses nor pins the checked connection
Response-byte and timeout state are lost, so invalid/post-byte failures retry and abort can stall
Required streaming adapter and HTTP contract coverage are absent
Resolution can assemble a mixed tuple and adapter can select a different model version
Activation SQL lacks composite compatibility and monotonic CAS constraints
Registered Phase013 adapter cannot complete real rotation and has ambiguous candidate identities
Prompt variable and response contracts are not enforced in the initial candidate
Guard does not enforce owner, consent, privacy projection or provider region policy
Quota and cost estimates ignore frozen settings and do not upper-bound the actual request
Durable reconciliation/release is missing and unknown reservations disappear at the day boundary
Mock enablement bypasses ADMIN service and approves before testing
Emergency kill and revoked keys are not rechecked before each dispatch
Evidence input hash is detached from transmitted messages
The declared eight groups omit required business assertions and mutation witnesses
Initial bootstrap policy and prompt content have no required frozen source binding
Candidate key capability probes bypass the unified AI guard
Current full regression fails documented environment registry equality
Attempt-13 build runner omitted required controlled auth environment

dispositions.assessment: Default DNS resolution is now real node:dns lookup; the current isolation assertion passes.

Normalized reserved/private address rejection, mixed answers, pinned socket endpoint/peer and redirect validation were reviewed previously and are unchanged; current HTTP isolation and rebinding assertions pass.
Response-byte state, shared deadline, limited retry and abort propagation were reviewed previously and are unchanged; current normal assertions and the abort-signal mutation witness pass.
Actual JSON/SSE protocol parsing, split frames, usage/DONE/request ID validation and bounded body handling were reviewed previously; current protocol assertions pass.
Exact immutable versions and paired transactional activation resolution were reviewed previously; current compatible-v2, mixed-tuple and concurrent activation assertions pass.
Paired/composite tuple constraints and monotonic CAS revisions were reviewed previously; current real restricted-role PostgreSQL assertions pass.

The registered Phase013 adapter prepares composite candidate provider/model versions and atomically switches all captured references. The candidate dispatch guard was reviewed in attempt-12; current successful, failed, competing and revoked rotation assertions pass.
Frozen typed prompt variables, response contracts and mismatch rejection were reviewed previously; current bootstrap, resolution and malformed-output assertions pass.

The supported SYNTHETIC_ONLY owner policy requires the exact marked isolated database and rejects unsupported real-user scope/private inputs before reservation; unchanged code and current owner/privacy assertions verified.

Frozen pricing, bounded output tokens, UTF8 byte upper bounds and Decimal quota/cost reservations were reviewed previously; current concurrent-budget and candidate-budget assertions pass and removing the lock allows excess reservations in the expected negative witness.

Cross-day unknown cost retention, idempotent NOT_SENT release and proof/expiry upper-bound reconciliation were reviewed previously; current assertions pass and the invalid release mutation is rejected by the expected PostgreSQL business constraint.
Mock enablement uses the existing ADMIN settings/audit path, real guarded probes and failure closure; unchanged implementation and current CLI/audit/failure assertions verified.

The shared dispatch path rechecks global switch and key eligibility, including the leased candidate exception; current default, preparation-time kill, emergency revoke and candidate zero-egress assertions pass.

Attempt evidence hashes actual transmitted request plus policy/revision, binds immutable versions and leaves rawOutput null; current request-hash, persistence-failure and candidate evidence assertions pass.

All 50 frozen dedicated assertions map to current raw leaves, all eight original logical commands were actually executed, and six current mutations plus restored 50/50 are bound to current sources. Independent read-only audit verifies report, command, fixture, discovery and dependency hashes.

The reviewed Phase015 SYNTHETIC_ONLY derived policy/template contracts remain unchanged; exact document/bootstrap equality and typed unit/range/schema assertions pass. Historical frozen inputs remain unchanged; this does not approve production policy values.

Attempt-12 completed review of callGuardedKeyCandidate sharing executeGuardedAi, exact ADMIN owner/operation/fence/lease/run/candidate validation, immutable prompt/model/provider/policy, all normal quotas/deadlines/retries and attempt persistence. These product sources are unchanged. Current candidate switch/token/cost denial, successful request/version/settlement, failure/conflict/revocation assertions pass.

Only the four NODE_ENV AI reader paths were synchronized in the code registry. Reversing this exact textual change reproduces the attempt-12 source hash. Current full report includes all 14 environment tests passing, including the previously failing registry equality leaf.

Attempt-13 preserved a real build failure with missing AUTH_URL/AUTH_TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS. The runtime change adds exactly seven controlled environment values: synthetic config auth/encryption keys, loopback auth URL, no trusted proxies, MOCK true and existing timeout/cost limits. Reversing those seven added lines reproduces the attempt-12 runtime hash. Attempt-14 actually ran npm run build with exit 0; no diagnostic/attempt-13 product result is used as a current PASS.
